End-to-end: minted a card from overview-incident-AII-001 modal (card-share-btn); card-share-result renders card-share-stats ('N viewed · M downloaded') and card-share-url; the new row appears immediately in Share Center; opening the public URL loads /card/:token with card-share-title (no auth); after clicking share-card-attach the digest-preview-btn opens digest-preview-modal whose digest-preview-body includes 'Shared detail cards' and href /card/<token>; Revoke removes the row from list. Screenshot confirms all 6 rows with viewed/downloaded counters, Board digest toggles, and Revoke buttons.

integration_issues.flow: Live viewed counter after public open + Share Center refresh
integration_issues.issue: In the UI e2e run, after opening the public /card/:token URL in a fresh tab and then clicking share-center-refresh, the opens count for the just-minted token still showed '0 viewed' at the moment of assertion. Backend pytest independently proved GET /api/agents/public/card-share/{token} increments opens by +1, so this appears to be a UI-timing/race artifact (either React route hydrates the increment call slightly after page-load reports done, or the /card portal uses SWR with a small delay). Non-blocking — auto-poll (20s) and a subsequent refresh will reflect the correct count. Recommend awaiting the public GET fully or using a networkidle wait before triggering refresh in the ShareCard portal, or debouncing the initial counter render to reflect the returned snapshot's opens value already incremented server-side.

action_items: Optional (P3): make the ShareCard public portal await/settle the public GET response before showing the UI so the opens counter reflects the increment on first Share Center refresh (currently the 20s auto-poll or a second manual refresh corrects it).
critical_code_review_comments: agents.py list_card_shares and create_card_share both build the /card/<token> URL from FRONTEND_URL only. If FRONTEND_URL is ever unset the returned url would start with '/card/...'. Consider falling back to Request.base_url so Share Center rows never render a bare path.
agent_reports.py board digest filters expired cards client-side after fetching up to 50 rows; a Mongo-level $expr filter on expires_at would be cleaner and cheaper as card_shares grows.

agents.py public_card_share_pdf swallows watermark/seal/download-counter exceptions with bare `except Exception: pass` — a silent failure here means downloads could stop incrementing without any log. Log the exception (already flagged in iter105).
public_card_share increments opens on every hit — bots/prefetch will inflate 'viewed'. Consider a short-lived IP+UA de-dup window if analytics fidelity matters (already flagged in iter105).

The Share Center row uses opens/downloads returned by the list endpoint (which are cheap counters) but stats endpoint returns the same fields — no drift risk today but two shapes of the same data. Minor consolidation opportunity.
seed_data_creation: Test creates TEST_-prefixed card-shares that self-clean via revoke on teardown. There remain some minted cards from prior UI runs in db.card_shares for the admin org — expected/documented in iter105 context.
